text:
Maya (People Ops): brainstorming: tiny packet of native wildflower seeds as a "Recognition Sprout" people can plant or keep on their desk. eco-forward, lightweight for shipping, and ties into our sustainability goals. thoughts? :seedling:
Ethan (Events): love the symbolism. packs could be branded kraft envelopes with a sticker and planting note. vendors: SeedlyPrint or EcoPackets. Some offer compostable sleeves.
Sana (Global Ops): shipping-wise seeds are tricky in some countries (AU, NZ, RU). we'll need country opt-outs or switch to a postcard+seedless sticker for those locations. Also check phytosanitary restrictions for EU imports.
Lina (Rewards): nice low-value keepsake. suggest including a 1-line prompt for managers: "Who helped you bloom?" that ties to #kudos. Also offer a digital badge for those who opt out.
Ben (Procurement): rough cost: 500 seed packets w/ sleeve and sticker ~ $1.10/unit if US-printed. Compostable sleeves + foil sticker ~ $1.55/unit. Lead time ~ 10 business days. I'll request quotes and ask about EU/UK drop-ship.
Maya (People Ops): target audience ~440 people incl contractors. plan order 475 to cover extras and lost mail. Priya (HR Ops) will check contractor accept scenarios but tagging Priya in thread.
hr-bot: Reminder: complete Gifts & Distribution sheet before placing the order: https://drive.company/gifts
Ethan (Events): copy idea for insert: "Plant a seed, share a thanks. Snap a pic and post to #kudos."
Sana (Global Ops): vendor will need CSV for addresses if doing direct-ship. Ben, can you confirm required fields and if vendor supports conditional fulfillment (e.g., send postcard instead of seeds for restricted countries)?
Ben (Procurement): vendor asked for: name,address_line1,address_line2,city,postal,country,email. I'll check conditional fulfillment flags and multi-origin printing options.
Maya (People Ops): timeline proposal: finalize messaging/art by Aug 4, place order Aug 8, receive/ship Aug 21-25 (Recognition Week Aug 24). Can we hit that?
Ethan (Events): yes, I'll mock two sleeve designs (kraft / green motif) and post in #design-review by Jul 29.
Lina (Rewards): I'll draft manager prompt and digital badge copy by Jul 25. Also, we should log distributions for tax/compliance records.
Sana (Global Ops): I'll compile a country list where seeds are restricted and propose alternatives (postcard/sticker). Expect to have list by Jul 28.
Ben (Procurement): I'll get quotes from SeedlyPrint and EcoPackets by Jul 26 and confirm lead times + PO template.
Maya (People Ops): action items: (1) Ethan design mockups (2) Ben vendor quotes + PO (3) Sana country restrictions + alt plan (4) Lina manager prompt + badge copy. I'll create a short RSVP + opt-out form and a Trello card. Anyone else to loop in?
Lina (Rewards): loop in Legal to confirm cross-border rules for plant materials and Procurement for any vendor agreements.
Maya (People Ops): perfect. fallback if seeds blocked: printed mini-plantables postcard (paper-embedded seeds sourced regionally) or a thrifted plant coupon. thanks team! :raised_hands:
